home.title: Wordhabit — Master a new word every day

home.ogDescription: Build a lasting vocabulary habit with daily words, flashcards, and streaks designed to make words stick.
home.twitterDescription: Learn better words daily with spaced repetition and flashcards that are actually fun to use.

discover.title: Discover
discover.description: Meet today’s word: what it means, how it sounds, a real example.

practice.title: Practice
practice.description: Flip through flashcards until the word feels familiar.

master.title: Master
master.description: Prove it in a short quiz and lock it in.

review.title: Review later
review.description: The word comes back right before you would forget it.

launch.question: Is Wordhabit available now?
launch.answer: Yes. Wordhabit is available now on Google Play and the App Store.

devices.question: Will it work on my phone?
devices.answer: Yes. Wordhabit works on Android and iPhone.

free.question: Is Wordhabit really free?
free.answer: Yes. The word of the day, flashcards and mastery are free forever. Pro is optional and adds extra quiz modes, several languages at once and streak repair.

dictionary.question: How is this different from a dictionary app?
dictionary.answer: Dictionaries are for lookups. Wordhabit is for retention: spaced review, real examples and quizzes move a word from “I have seen that” to “I use that”.

duration.question: How long is a daily session?
duration.answer: About five minutes: discover the word, practice with cards, prove it in a short quiz. The review comes back days later, right before you would forget.

a.description: Wordhabit teaches one word a day, deeply. Discover it, practice it, master it, review it later: one small journey a day, and the word is yours.

b.description: One word with your coffee. Three small steps, a streak that keeps you honest, and tomorrow a new word is waiting.

c.description: Spaced review brings each word back just before you would forget it, until it moves from seen-it to use-it.

manifesto.lineOne: Most apps race you through ten words a day, and by Friday they are gone.
manifesto.lineTwoLast: and the time to truly make it yours.
manifesto.lineThreeFirst: A year from now, that is

languages.ownLanguage: Plenty of words you don’t know yet exist in your own language. Pick the one you already speak and enrich it, one day at a time.

sharedWord.seoSuffix: Learn it in context and remember it for good with a little Wordhabit practice every day.
sharedWord.subtitle: Get the free app and make it a habit.

notFound.title: This word has flown.
notFound.message: The link may have expired, but a new word is waiting in the app every day.

seo.title: Wordhabit Pro — Go deeper. No limits.
seo.description: Try Wordhabit Pro free for 7 days: extra quiz modes, several languages at once and streak repair. The word of the day stays free forever.

hero.description: The word of the day stays free, forever. Pro is for the day one language is not enough, one quiz mode is not enough, and one missed day should not cost your streak.
hero.trialNote: Try Pro free for 7 days from the app. Cancel anytime, the free habit stays.
hero.cardTrial: 7 days free, then the price shown in the app

features.description: Pro does not add more words to your day. It adds more ways to keep the one you learned.

quizModes.title: Real world and Speed quizzes
quizModes.body: Prove a word in a real situation, or against the clock. Two more ways to make it stick, on top of Mastery.

languages.title: Several languages at once
languages.body: English, French and Spanish, each with its own word of the day, its own streak and its own progress.

streakRepair.title: Streak repair
streakRepair.body: One missed day no longer erases weeks of habit. Repair it and keep going.

one.title: Get the app
one.body: Install Wordhabit, or open it if you already have it.

two.title: Open Pro from your profile
two.body: The Pro card sits at the top of your profile. Tap it to see the plans and the price for your country.

three.title: Start your 7 free days
three.body: Nothing is charged before day 8, and you can cancel from your store account at any time.

after.question: What happens after the 7 days?
after.answer: The plan you picked starts, at the price shown in the app before you subscribed. Cancel before day 8 and nothing is charged.

cancel.question: Can I cancel?
cancel.answer: Yes, at any time, from your Google Play or App Store subscriptions. Pro stays active until the end of the period you paid for.

free.question: Do I lose anything without Pro?
free.answer: No. The word of the day, flashcards and mastery are free forever. Pro adds to the habit, it never takes from it.
